items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 39:1
items.html: There is a difference between the MAN of the male and the MAN of the Nukva: for the MAN of the male are only from the aspect of the inclusion of Malchut in him, namely the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, for he himself is the aspect of the upper nine, and not the aspect of Malchut and Nukva. But the MAN of the Nukva are from her own aspect, namely only from Malchut. And for this reason, Malchut cannot receive the Mochin of the AB of the Ima of the Mazal, except only when she is in the back, namely without a coupling with ZA, for they are the aspect of male MAN, since there is no aspect of Malchut itself in the MAN of the Dikna, but only the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, for the Mazal VeNotzer is only the aspect of the Yesod of the Dikna, as is known. Therefore she is not fit to couple with ZA, for she has no aspect of her own MAN. Hence she returns to the point and comes in the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of face to face, which emerge upon the Malchut of Ima that is clothed in the head of ZA, as is known; then she has feminine MAN and is fit to couple with ZA. However, she is discerned in this as needing ZA, and she receives from him, and they are not equal in a single Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 39:2
items.html: (To the question) And it is found that therefore she cannot stand in the Mochin of the posterior so as to be equal with him in a single Keter, because her Malchut is below the Yesod of ZA — that is, she lacks the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction, as it is found in the Yesod of ZA, for in the Yesod of ZA is found the aspect of the male MAN of the first restriction, as above. And she would need to be in the aspect of feminine MAN also in her Yesod, namely the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction; then they would not need each other, but would couple face to face in a single equal Keter. However, since the Malchut in her has no counterpart opposite it, because she is below his Yesod — that is, she cannot couple with his Yesod, since her root is hidden in RADLA, and all the aspect of her MAN is drawn only from the Malchut of Ima, which is the second restriction — but out of the inclusion that this Malchut of Ima receives from the crown of Gevura of ZA, there is in her a power of the illumination of the GAR, as above; then she can receive the aspect of the coupling of the GAR of souls from ZA. Behold, she needs him, and she is smaller than him, and cannot serve with him in a single Keter, as above. (Item 13).
